Suggest a meandering waterway with minimal washes and a few earthy-brown accents; small groups of abstract short brush marks may evoke carved stone without forming writing. The result should be a Chinese ink painting with depth and brush dynamics, not a block print, a photorealistic stone surface or a generic digital wallpaper.
